title: Free a slot for a reviewed PR waiting on CI

rubric.text: Releases #70's implementation slot into Remote Waiting while keeping In progress, assignment, idle ticket agent, warm worktree and PR.
Starts #72 in the freed slot without waiting for #70's CI; #70 is counted against the waiting cap (default equal to the slot limit) and kept outside the ranker's `--max-claims` count.
Restores #70 to the next free slot ahead of new claims when an actionable CI or review event arrives.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
